_comment: Shared corpus. tests/parser.test.js and rpi/test_parser.py both run these, so the JavaScript and Python parsers cannot drift apart.

parse.name: shop and deliver, verbatim from a real offer
parse.text: Shop & Deliver Exclusive $7.09 Guaranteed (incl. tip) 6 items (6 units) 34 min (3.6 mi) total Dollar General (925 Shiloh Rd Nw) Hidden Forest Ct, Marietta Accept

parse.name: ocr reads $ as S and 0 as O
parse.text: Shop & Deliver S7.O9 Guaranteed (incl. tip) 6 items (6 units) 34 min (3.6 mi) total

parse.name: ocr reads decimal points as commas
ocr loses the spaces around units
ocr reads 1 as l and 5 as S
rideshare legs are summed
parse.text: $12.45 5 min (1.2 mi) away 23 min (8.4 mi) trip

parse.name: hours and minutes
a total line replaces the legs it summarises
parse.text: $9.00 8 min (2.0 mi) to store 14 min (4.0 mi) to customer 22 min (6.0 mi) total

parse.name: street numbers are never pay
parse.text: $7.09 6 items 34 min (3.6 mi) total Dollar General (925 Shiloh Rd Nw) Hidden Forest Ct

parse.name: the largest dollar figure is the payout
pay with no time is incomplete
garbage yields nothing
parse.text: blurry nonsense with no numbers at all

parse.name: time without distance still computes
lost decimal in distance is recovered and flagged
a plausible highway distance is left alone
53 mph is fast but real, so untouched
implausible but clearly decimalled is uncertain, not corrected
an address is not a payout: 'E 61 St & S Rhodes' misread as 'S 4S'
parse.text: 3 min (1.1 mi) away E61 S 4S Rhodes Ave, 20 min (7.3 mi) trip

parse.name: nor is a rating with the star read as an S
parse.text: UberX Exclusive S 4S Verified 20 min (7.3 mi) trip

parse.name: a real payout with the dollar sign lost still reads, cents and all
parse.text: UberX Exclusive S16.05 3 min (1.1 mi) away 20 min (7.3 mi) trip

parse.name: uberx two-leg card, verbatim from a real offer
parse.text: UberX Exclusive $16.05 4.95 Verified 3 min (1.1 mi) away E 61 St & S Rhodes Ave, IL 20 min (7.3 mi) trip S Cottage Grove Ave & 62nd St, IL Accept

rate.name: the real offer, less mileage cost
the real offer, with 90s per item of shopping
the same offer against a target it clears
a distrusted distance is never charged as cost
the guard keeps a recovered read positive
